initialisation.note: The depth-3 state checkpoint is produced by the matrix phase, which runs after this probe; the G-v3 small-set criterion is a delta from the initialisation, so a deterministic fresh seed-7 initialisation is used and recorded here.  No cross-depth weights are transplanted (design C4).

aux_note: This probe trains the policy objective alone so the ranking signal is not masked by the auxiliary heads; the formal policy stage adds hm=.1/xy=1/danger=.2/self=.1 and is measured by the throughput phase.
